facts.fact: The ARPCE launched on 7 September 2026 a tender for mobile coverage of 3000 localities of under 2000 inhabitants, with financing wholly assured by the state through the universal service mechanism for electronic communications; a similar 1,400-locality 4G programme is being completed.
facts.system: Service universel des communications électroniques (universal service mechanism)
